summary: Full frontend regression of the v2 intelligence-layer rewrite. All 14 required feature areas verified end-to-end at 1920x1080 (and mobile 375x812 smoke): landing upgrade-notice + localStorage clearing on schema mismatch; 11-step assessment flow with new rating legend ('1 = STRONGEST · 10 = NEEDS MOST ATTENTION') + .rating-anchors; multi-select obstacles; money moneyGoals multi-select (deep-multi-money-moneyGoals-savings etc.); inverted Life Score formula (ratings 8,7,5,5,5,5 → 46, matches Math.round((10-avg)*100/9)); Top 3 Priorities panel with URGENT/IMPORTANT/OPPORTUNITY tiers; goal-urgency boost verified (goal contains 'promoted' → Career=7+1.5=8.5 outranks Health=8, Career becomes URGENT); Life Twin 3 coach-style paragraphs; Next Best Action with What/When/HowOften/Why/IfYouDo/IfYouDont; Mark Complete on URGENT priority correctly (a) shows priority-done-urgent, (b) auto-completes NBA (progress jumps 0→2/4), (c) flips Life Risk Radar career row to 'Improving' (.level-badge.improving present), (d) updates future-trend-note to 'You have completed the recommended action'. 7 risk rows render; 5 future horizons + 3 trajectories present with projected numbers. Six area cards render inline with 3–5 verified authoritative sources each (WHO/CDC/BLS/SEBI/AMFI/MS Learn/etc.). State persists across full page reload (priority-done-urgent still visible). Start over clears storage and returns to landing WITHOUT upgrade-notice. Zero console errors captured across the entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec vs implementation minor mismatch: review_request states 'all ratings at 5 → score 50', but Math.round((10-avg)*100/9) with avg=5 yields 56 (50 is only produced at avg=5.5). Endpoints (1→100, 10→0) are correct and the direction is right. If exact 5→50 is desired, either (a) update the spec note to say '5 → ~56 (moderate)' or (b) redefine mapping as Math.round((10-avg)*100/9) centered at 5 via (10-avg)/9 with a shift, or use avg mapped 1..10 → 100..0 as round((10-avg)*100/9). Recommend fixing docs, not the formula, since the linear-between-endpoints mapping is what the spec literally describes.

Dashboard.jsx is ~446 lines with 10+ inline sub-components (ScoreRing, LevelBadge, CurrentStatePanel, PriorityCard, TopThreeSection, ObstaclePanel, TwinPanel, NextActionPanel, RiskRadar, FutureSelfPanel, ProgressPanel, AreaCard). Approaching the 700-line guideline but readable; consider splitting each panel into its own file under components/dashboard/ for maintainability and lazy testing.
completeAction() in Dashboard.jsx creates two Date().toISOString() calls in one code path; extract to a single `now` const to guarantee identical timestamps on the paired priority+NBA completion.

Streak logic in ProgressPanel is naive: shows '1 Day' whenever completedCount > 0 and '0 Days' otherwise. It does not model consecutive days across sessions — acceptable for MVP but worth calling out.
seed_data_creation: Seeded old-schema payload {assessment:{goal,ratings}} into localStorage['life-upgrade-ai-state'] to verify upgrade-notice + auto-clear path; then completed full 11-step assessment with goal='I want to get promoted to Senior PM this year', ratings health=8/career=7/others=5, obstacles=[Procrastination,Stress], consistency=Sometimes, and full deep-dive answers for all six areas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2 rewrite is functionally complete and stable. Playwright range-slider workaround (native setter + dispatch 'input') works. Money multi-select selectors use kebab-cased option (e.g., deep-multi-money-moneyGoals-emergency-fund). URGENT tier is decided by combined score (rating + goalBoost + frictionBoost + consistencyPenalty), so priority ordering can vary with goal keywords. Only open observation is the spec-vs-formula '5→50' phrasing (see critical_code_review_comments).
rca of the issue: No issues found in this iteration.
